description: The Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed is the Flanders Heritage Agency's inventory of valuable immovable heritage in Flanders, covering archaeological, architectural, landscape and floating heritage. Two full datasets can be downloaded as CSV and are regenerated every night. Designation objects (aanduidingsobjecten) describe the legal status: protected monuments, archaeological sites, landscapes and town and village views, heritage landscapes, UNESCO World Heritage cores and buffers, and the adopted inventories of architectural heritage, archaeological zones, historic gardens and parks, and woody plantings with heritage value. Heritage objects (erfgoedobjecten) are the items inventoried on scientific criteria, with id, name, location and typology. Coverage: the Flemish Region. Access: free CSV files of about 74 MB (designations) and 27 MB (heritage objects), last changed 26 September 2026, plus a subset for woody plantings; search results can be exported in lists of up to 2,000 objects. Licence: texts are offered under the Flemish model licence for free reuse and CC BY-SA 4.0, both requiring attribution. Caveats: some texts come from external partners and local authorities; the downloads give locations and typology, not building condition. Simulation uses are protected building and site locations for flood and heat exposure and for adaptation planning. Related records: the Dutch Rijksmonumenten register and the Irish NIAH inventory.
